meta.name: summarization
meta.description: Transform large, noisy, or short-term memory into compact, durable, high-signal summaries. Activate when session memory grows large, decisions accumulate, or memory retrieval starts returning too many files.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将杂乱的长程记忆提炼为精炼摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的AI助手需要从大量会话记忆中提炼要点。
copy.tagline_en: Distill messy long-term memory into concise summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI agent needs to extract key points from overwhelming session memory.

howto.what: 将大量、嘈杂或短期会话记忆转换为紧凑、高信息密度的摘要。它会提取已确认的决策、稳定约束、当前优先级等关键信息，用结构化模板保存，并归档原始记录以节省上下文空间。
howto.when: 当会话记忆变得很大、跨会话决策积累、项目上下文碎片化、记忆检索返回太多文件或令牌消耗明显增加时触发。对于每个记忆类别，如果文件数超过5个或估计令牌超过5000也会触发。

say.text: 帮我压缩当前会话的记忆，只保留重要决策和约束。
say.note: 生成摘要并归档原始文件。

say.text: 总结项目中已确认的优先级和尚未解决的问题。
归档讨论历史，创建摘要替换原始文件。
say.note: 更新索引，保留可审计的归档。

howto.what_en: Compresses large, noisy, or short-term session memory into compact, durable, high-signal summaries. It extracts confirmed decisions, stable constraints, current priorities, and other key information, saves them in a structured template, and archives raw records to save context space.
howto.when_en: Triggers when session memory grows large, decisions accumulate, context becomes fragmented, memory retrieval returns too many files, or token usage increases. For each memory category, triggers if file count >5 or estimated tokens >5000.

say_en.text: Compress the current session memory, keeping only important decisions and constraints.
say_en.note: Generates summary and archives raw files.

say_en.text: Summarize confirmed priorities and open questions in the project.
Archive discussion history and create a summary to replace raw files.
